## Problem / hypothesis

## Scope

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Fix evaluation criteria, data splits, seeds, and budgets before running experiments.
- [ ] Complete the scoped deliverable and relevant validation.
- [ ] Preserve measured results, limitations, and negative findings.
- [ ] Update the repository ticket and PRIORITIES.md together.

## Metrics / evidence

Name the metrics, comparison budgets, expected reports, and source/configuration provenance.

## Dependencies

List stable ticket IDs and actual GitHub links when available. Required decision
tickets must record `proceed`; closure alone does not satisfy a research gate.

## Completion record

Add actual implementation/report links, validation commands/results, and the scientific
outcome. Do not equate completed implementation with a supported hypothesis.
